model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the relationship between average lagging (AL) and BLEU score for four different conditions. The x-axis is labeled “Average Lagging (AL)” and utilizes a linear scale ranging from 2.5 to 10.0, with tick labels spaced at intervals of 0.5. The y-axis is labeled “BLEU” and ranges from approximately 25.5 to 33.0, using tick intervals of 0.5. A blue dashed line with markers displays a trend from approximately 27.0 at AL = 2.5 to approximately 30.5 at AL = 10.0. A purple dashed-dotted line with markers transitions from approximately 26.0 at AL = 2.5 to approximately 31.0 at AL = 10.0. A black solid line with markers begins at approximately 29.0 at AL = 2.5 and maintains a relatively steady value around 31.0 until AL = 10.0. Lastly, a red solid line with markers begins at approximately 28.0 at AL = 2.5 and increases to approximately 32.0 at AL = 10.0.
